captions.linkedin:
Past bond returns predict future equity returns. Across 20 countries.

That's the result the JFE published in 2020, and it's the kind of thing almost nobody trades on retail platforms.

The paper: Pitkäjärvi, Suominen & Vaittinen, Journal of Financial Economics (2020). The mechanic:

🔹 RANK 20 DEVELOPED COUNTRIES by trailing bond returns AND trailing equity returns (12-month lookback)
🔹 LONG EQUITY in countries where bonds rallied (positive cross-signal)
🔹 SHORT EQUITY in countries where bonds sold off
🔹 SAME LOGIC INVERTED for bonds (equity returns negatively predict next-period bonds)
🔹 COMBINE with standard own-asset time-series momentum
🔹 MONTHLY REBALANCE

The hypothesized mechanism: slow-moving institutional capital rotating between bond and equity allocations doesn't move in one day, it moves over months. The cross-asset signal picks up that drift before price catches up.

The result documented: Sharpe ratio 45% higher than single-asset TSM. Works in 19 of 20 countries tested.

Regime gate to monitor: positive stock-bond correlation can flip the sign of the signal.

Strategy shared free. Performance depends on execution, sizing, and risk gates, that's the part we engineer.
